rows.name: Transformers And Rectifiers (India) Ltd
rows.notes: The screen's 'latest' figure of Rs 21,000 cr is a MISREAD of the 13-Oct-2026 Q2FY27 earnings-call transcript (filed on NSE 21-Oct-2026). The sentence it matched is CMD Satyen Mamtora answering a competition question: 'we have close to about 21,000 crores order in hand OR INQUIRIES that are being pending to be finalized' - an order book PLUS enquiry pipeline, not an order book. Management states the order book itself in its opening remarks on the SAME call, page 6: 'As of 30th September 2026, our unexecuted order book stood at 7,237 crore, up by 32% year-on-year ... executable over the next 18 to 24 months.' The year-ago figure the screen used, Rs 5,500 cr as on 30-Sep-2025, IS genuine: in the Q2FY26 transcript (BSE 17-Nov-2025) the analyst asks 'our order book as on 30th September is about INR5,500 crores, 30th September order book?' and Mamtora answers 'Yes.' So the true year-on-year change on comparable definitions is 7,237/5,500 = +31.6%, which independently matches management's own '+32% year-on-year'. Below the 50% bar, so NOT A JUMP and no trigger exists. Recorded with qualifies=false so the row is not re-checked unless TARIL files a newer order book. Size note: TARIL is far above this page's Rs 200-7,500 cr band, so no idea card would follow even if it had qualified.

rows.notes: Both ends re-read from the company's own earnings-call transcripts this run. Q1 FY27 transcript (filed BSE 3-Aug-2026): 'The order book position as on 30th June 2026, is INR 1,244 crore out of which 88% that is INR 1,096 crore is from products. On 31st March, 2026, the order book position was INR 1,044 crore, out of which 86%, that is INR 899 crore is from products.' Q1 FY26 transcript (filed BSE 5-Aug-2025): 'The order book position is Rs. 703.16 crore including Rs. 608.70 crore of products business and Rs. 94.46 crore of projects and services business. On March 31, 2025, the order book position was Rs. 612.40 crore.' Same definition on both sides (products + projects and services), company-wide, not a segment. book_to_ttm_sales uses the four quarters to Jun-2026 from BSE's detailed-results feed: 196.37 + 202.00 + 206.80 + 193.69 = Rs 798.86 cr. CAVEAT the reader needs: management confirmed on the same call that the book 'includes the AMC contracts also' and that contracts extend 'up to 5 years', so this is not an EPC-style backlog and 1.56x is not 1.56 years of revenue in hand. The figure is disclosed ONLY in call transcripts - the 21-May-2026 results filing and board outcome carry no order-book number. Published as an idea card this run (2026-10-23-NUCLEUS).
